statement: Find the equation of the tangent to the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}=25$ at the point $(3,4)$.
solution: The radius to $(3,4)$ has gradient $\\tfrac43$, so the tangent has gradient $-\\tfrac34$. Using the tangent formula for $x^{2}+y^{2}=R^{2}$ at $(x_{0},y_{0})$: $x_{0}x+y_{0}y=R^{2}$, giving $3x+4y=25$.
hints: The tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point.
Use $x_{0}x+y_{0}y=R^{2}$ for a circle centred at the origin.
